A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Can you repair my car at my home? +

We offer mobile dent, scratch, bumper, and paint repair throughout South Florida. The location and damage determine what can be repaired on site. Send photos so our team can recommend mobile service or a visit to our shop.

Can my repair be done the same day? +

Same-day service is available for qualifying repairs. Timing depends on the damage, parts, and availability. Our team will confirm the expected turnaround when reviewing your estimate.

How do I get an estimate? +

Call or text (954) 905-2386. Include your vehicle’s year, make, model, your city, and clear photos of the damage. Our estimate helper below can prepare the details for you.

Do you offer pick-up and delivery? +

Smart Way offers free pick-up and delivery. Contact the team to confirm availability and arrangements for your location and repair.
